# owner: platform
"""Seating charts: students sorted by last name, in rows."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _name(item: Student) -> str:
    return f"{item.last_name}, {item.first_name}"


# ---
def seating_rows(
    students: List[Student], seats: int
) -> List[str]:
    """One text line per row, sorted by last name."""
    if seats <= 0 or not students:
        raise ProjectError("need students and seats")
    names = sorted(map(_name, students))
    rows = [names[at:at + seats]
            for at in range(0, len(names), seats)]
    return [f"Row {num}: " + " | ".join(row)
            for num, row in enumerate(rows, 1)]
